# Holiday fonts

The holiday greetings on the "Who's watching?" screen use these fonts from
[google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts), copied into `app/src/main/res/font/`:

| File | Font | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| holiday_creepster.ttf | Creepster | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| holiday_mountains.ttf | Mountains of Christmas Bold | Apache License 2.0 |
| holiday_monoton.ttf | Monoton | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| holiday_greatvibes.ttf | Great Vibes | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| holiday_lobster.ttf | Lobster | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| holiday_bungee.ttf | Bungee | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| holiday_playfair_italic.ttf | Playfair Display Italic | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| holiday_pacifico.ttf | Pacifico | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
